notes.title: TinkerQuarry v1.0 Now Available + Soundtrack!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29109964/25c48e36943cd7cd46ea5a1c1ee13040c700caa7.png[/img]

[h1]As of 09/13/2019, TinkerQuarry has exited Early Access. The game is now fully available for purchase on the Steam store page. [/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/651280/TinkerQuarry/

First and foremost, I want to give an earnest, personal Thank-You to all of the Early Access testers and Dollhouse Denizens that made this project possible. This game would have never come as far as it has if it wasn't for your wonderful feedback, support, and patience!

I'd also like to thank the individuals that helped contribute to the project in the form of music and other assets:

Antriksh Bali was the primary composer for TinkerQuarry, whom brought his talents to the project and created a truly incredible auditory experience for the games' many locations + battle sequences. In conjunction with the games' v1.0 update, Bali has released the TinkerQuarry Original soundtrack on a variety of streaming platforms, which you can check out below. It would mean a lot to all of us at Caprizant Games if you'd consider supporting him by purchasing the album!

https://www.antrikshbali.com/
[url=https://antrikshbali.bandcamp.com/album/tinkerquarry-original-game-soundtrack]Bandcamp Album: TinkerQuarry Soundtrack[/url]
[url=https://open.spotify.com/album/51EVU8HwZ4s0jPFOYilY65?si=B-gXH5pOSW6I-4A4cKc5DQ]Spotify Playlist: TinkerQuarry Soundtrack[/url]

NOTE: The songs in-game have been lightly edited/cut for better playback with RPGMaker2003's music looping. The only way to get the full, High-Quality versions is by checking out the links above!

Further honorable mentions:

Julia Harkin, the original musician whom created a few tracks for the game during its Pre-Beta and Beta periods (before the game was even on Steam!) Her work can be found on [url=https://cheesemakesmusic.tumblr.com]Tumblr[/url].

Ender, for being both a fantastic friend and worldbuilding partner, with whom I'd frequently bounce back and forth ideas and concepts for the game.

Lemony, Luka, Jess, and Brandon, for being incredible Discord moderators and testers, as well as close irl friends who have helped me a ton personally over the near-5 year development of this game.

CircusPuma, for creating and managing the TinkerQuarry TV Tropes page since 2017.

Jack, who owns the real-life inspiration for Peter / Peter's design.

and finally Bituin-Queen, for creating Odettes' iconic Music Box theme!

[b]The Future[/b]

So, what's next, you may be asking? I've already touched on the subject briefly before in other news updates, but for the sake of a recap and overall reiteration, here's what I currently have planned.

[list]
[*]TinkerQuarry will continue to receive periodic updates post v1.0. This will most likely include visual updates (new assets, artwork, etc.), and minor bugfixes / changes if needed (any remaining errors, dialogue, syntax, etc.).
[*]There will not be any more main plot-related changes that will massively impact current in-game switches, so the game can continue to be playable in its current state no matter the save from here on out. (as Opposed to Early Access, where resets frequently had to be made)
[*]The addition of more recruitable characters aside from the current cast is being tested.
[*]Support for the TinkerQuarry Discord Server will continue for as long as it is relatively active
[*]New projects and games will be announced via this Discord and other social media
[/list]

That's all for now! I hope you enjoy TinkerQuarry v1.0 and I am looking forward to both providing continued support and new content down the road!

notes.content:

notes.title: Hotfix v0.6.5
notes.content:
Minor technical hotfix update to fix some issues with the last patch. 
As always, please report any bugs to #bug-reports in the Discord server so I can clean them up ASAP!

Major fixes:
- Fixed issue with comfort cutscene that caused it to repeat and / or have characters in party not present
-Fixed issue with Tea party cutscene where it would play twice with different characters if the party consisted of Whiskers and Skid
-Fixed being able to escape Chimera fight by walking along the wall

Minor fixes:
-"Frelly" is now "Freely" in Clints Journal
-Fixed some Tira dialogue issues and decreased her walk frequency
-Added area to starting room to be utilized later
-Fixed bug where the player could slide backwards away from Wemblin if moving between dialogue boxes
-Made Wemblin say "Ran" less often.

notes.title: Release Version 0.5.1
notes.content:
Released May 30th

Major Changes:
-All new soundtrack tracks by Antriksh Bali (some need loop tweaking)
-Lori Redesign
-Righthand side of Locked Halls for extended story content
-Stat changes to reflect character "Classes" (Ex: Peter is now more of a "Tank" class)
-Title Screen Update with company splash logo
-New Enemies and Environmental Threat: Tinker Rats and Void Arms
-New Characters, NPCs, first pass of Raffle Character "Wemblin" ( designed by Skid Enthusiast on DIscord ! )
- Fourth Floor redesign ( Glass Dragon as a static Sprite and not an image, puzzle for lever )
- New "Weight" Sprite ( because Staya isn't all that talented )
- Other Additional puzzles, changing Locked Halls route to the lower Rez hall
- " Flashbacks " ( 2/4 done )
- Dialogue Additions and tweaks
- Player will now crawl in vents
- Tweak to all battle BGs so sprites mostly stay in center frame and not obscured by HUD


Minor Changes
- Loads of bugfixes ( Stella, advice system, etc)
- New Clint note
-Nerfed Staya and other bosses to accommodate stat changes
-Lowered cost of Ire's healing service to 100 teeth per use


PLEASE START A NEW GAME FOR THIS PATCH. Story content has changed and areas once open may now be closed unless certain tasks are taken. Many switches have been tweaked as well.

Other News: The next few patches will be smaller, adding primarily story content, new enemies, and experimental features such as the Toy "Element" battle system, and Camime Puzzles. All of this will then build up to the "end" of the game, which will be the next megapatch. We're in the home stretch now! 

_____

Current saves should be retained per-computer.
HOWEVER, (in the rare case that it is not....

How do I save my current save file to use it in an upcoming update? 
-Go to the TinkerQuarry Steam folder and locate each file that says "save". Copy these to a separate folder and carry them back over to the new version once it updates. Until Steam Cloud is implemented, all saves will be wiped from the Steam Folder, so it is recommended to save them elsewhere if the next version is compatible.

The details in this post may be updated and are subject to change. Thank you for all your help, and don't stop giving feedback if you find an issue!

Keep up to date on development with our community discord: https://discord.gg/KHeNXFv

notes.title: Release Version 0.4.1
notes.content:
Released January 7th 

Major Changes:
- New short introduction clip featuring Peter and the Player
- Adjusted battle tutorial dialogue for better pacing
- Item descriptions now indicate if they are Equippable
-Changed "Charm" Equip slot name to "Amulet" to prevent confusion with lesser items
-New Clint note describing each Status effect

Minor changes:
-Fixed Whiskers becoming "Normal" colored post-battle instead of Impaired
-Fixed bug where players without Clint would recieve him near the end of the patch ( UPDATE: Now he will vanish if the players already had him before the fight. This will be fixed ASAP in a small patch. Thank you Discord Testers! )
-Other minor bugfixes and adjustments
-Starting room now has details on controls on the floor
-New pickup sound effects, and door opening/closing sound effects. I will be phasing out as many RTP placeholder sounds as possible in the coming months.

Other News: Starting work on a possible experimental "Class" system and the ability to switch between recruitable characters. (You will be able to repair Lori, for example, and recruit her. You will also be able to swap Skid out for Whiskers at HQ or vice versa at any time.) 

EX:
Tinkers will be strong against Softies
Softies will be strong against Plastics
Plastics will be strong against Amalgams
Amalgams will be strong against Tinkers
Souls (Human class) will be neutral against all others

Many new enemy types will be added to reflect each of these Classes, with the color of their Essences dictating their Class. 

Expect Testing Branch patches reflecting these systems implemented in the coming months, along with regular updates. 

_____

Current saves should be retained per-computer.
HOWEVER, (in the rare case that it is not....


Safe to carry over older version save file? 
-Go ahead. (Though you will be missing some bits)


How do I save my current save file to use it in an upcoming update? 
-Go to the TinkerQuarry Steam folder and locate each file that says "save". Copy these to a separate folder and carry them back over to the new version once it updates. Until Steam Cloud is implemented, all saves will be wiped from the Steam Folder, so it is recommended to save them elsewhere if the next version is compatible.

The details in this post may be updated and are subject to change. Thank you for all your help, and don't stop giving feedback if you find an issue!

Keep up to date on development with our community discord: https://discord.gg/KHeNXFv

notes.title: Release Version 0.3.9
notes.content:
Released December 10


Major Changes:
-Added story progression and a new choice-based boss battle
- Nerfed Tear again, enemies will recover from it much quicker (25% chance of recovery ) but it will still do substantial damage if Spilling comes into effect 
- Setting up a strategy to make Cotton Candy and Coffee Bean status effects ( Blessed and Pumped ) to only last 20 turns in battle to give an initial buff to players. The item will be forcefully unequipped from the "Charm" slot mid-battle to stop the status effect from persisting. This was done since these items granted immunity from boss inflicted negative status such as Crippled or Spilling 
- Adeline will now learn a SP restoring move at Level 3 , and Peter at level 4

Minor changes:
-Reduced some of the text in the HQ section
-increased Camime puzzle difficulty slightly
-Some small stat changes
-Various bugfixes

Other News: TQ's updated soundtrack is nearly fully funded. Any donations are still welcome.

I will be working on TQ throughout the holidays. Thank you all for being so patient! It was a good semester. 


_____

Current saves should be retained per-computer.
HOWEVER, (in the rare case that it is not....


Safe to carry over older version save file?

notes.title: Raffle! (8/5 - 8/15)
notes.content:
Its time for a YCH (Your Character Here) random raffle! Starting now until the 15th, I will be taking community submissions for anyone who would like to enter their own TQ Toy character design(s), for a chance to be chosen to be added into the main game.

-NOTE: You do not NEED to submit a drawing, just a well thought out description will do. However, if you have something specific in mind, a visual would be best. 

I will choose THREE random winners on/after the 15th. Each winner's character will get:
-Their own room + custom room decor
-Their own sprites / icons and animations 
-Custom item "gift" to give to the player (if applicable) 
-Their own dialogue 
-Creator's name in the credits
- (Requests are open for further additions)

These characters will populate an upcoming segment of the Dollhouse the player may explore.

BONUS: Winners who are also Donators (Contributed $10 or more) may request to have their character play a more important role in the story! (EX: Boss battle, a recruitable party member, etc) This can be discussed further once the raffle is over. 

RULES: 
- No copyrighted designs. 
- Characters will be NPCs only and not major characters (unless the winner is a Donator, in which a plotting period will take place before they are added).
- Owners of winning characters will not receive financial gain for their design's use. However, your name will be credited in the credits of the game both in EA and post-release. 
- Does not need to be overly well-developed but a quirk/personality is preferred.
-Must be balanced and applicable to the TQ universe.

Have fun! PM me submissions on Discord or submit them to the Steam Community Artwork page (with the word "Raffle" in the title / description).

If your character is description only, put it in the Discussions area.

DISCORD LINK: https://discord.gg/KHeNXFv
DONATION LINK: https://www.paypal.me/CassandraClery
